method.summary: GPT-6 Astra driven through Codex with a self-built harness and open access to the NetHack wiki and spoilers. Ascended a Dwarf Valkyrie in 37,140 turns on the third attempt; a Hardfought dumplog is published.
method.interface: Text terminal through a self-built Codex harness, with the wiki and spoilers open
method.interface_zh: 通过自建的 Codex 框架操作文字终端，可查阅 wiki 和攻略
method.human_intervention: A human handled setup and resumed sessions (as reported).

notes: NetHack 3.6.7. Minetown and Sokoban are not claimed (not required for ascension); the other milestones follow from the ascension. No video found; the evidence is ttyrec recordings and dumplogs. Times are active play hours, estimated from the replay viewer's timeline with long idle pauses removed; they are not a published figure. Wall-clock from start to ascension was about 294 hours across 12 days. Medusa's time is an upper bound (arrival at the Castle). The Quest was entered after Gehennom (turn 28,330).
